title: Histogram with Equal-Width Bins
learning_objectives: Assign values to bins including the right edge
hints: Resolve lo/hi defaults first, then `w = (hi - lo) / bins`.
`edges = [lo + j * w for j in range(bins + 1)]`.
For each x in range, `j = int((x - lo) / w)`; if `j == bins` set `j = bins - 1`.

failure_feedback.advice: The maximum value must go in the last (closed) bin — clamp index bins → bins−1.
Skip values below lo or above hi.
When lo == hi, widen to [lo−0.5, hi+0.5].
A value exactly on an interior edge belongs to the bin on its right.
